Mesh LLM pools GPUs and memory across machines and exposes the result as one
OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:9337/v1

Usage: mesh-llm [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  setup   Finish first-time setup
  serve   Start serving / join mesh
  client  Run an API-only client
  help    Print this message

Options:
  --port <PORT>  OpenAI API port [default: 9337]
  -h, --help     Print help
